description:
• Brand introduction:

Introducing Ciami Bali, your new go-to destination for stylish and sustainable bikinis that are perfect for soaking up the sun and making a statement on the beach. Inspired by the tropical paradise of Bali, our brand offers a range of bikinis that blend comfort, style, and sustainability.

At Ciami Bali, we believe that every woman deserves to feel confident and comfortable in her own skin, which is why we've crafted each of our bikinis with the utmost care and attention to detail. From flattering cuts to vibrant prints, our designs are made to make you feel your best.

But we don't just care about how our bikinis look and feel – we're also passionate about making a positive impact on the planet. That's why all of our swimwear is made from eco-friendly materials, such as recycled nylon, and produced using ethical and sustainable practices.

Whether you're lounging poolside or catching waves in the ocean, Ciami Bali has the perfect bikini for you. So go ahead, shop our collection today and discover your new favorite swimsuit.

 
• Product Description:

Ciami Bali has an array of stunning and sustainable swimwear pieces that is sure to make heads turn on the beach. Made from eco-friendly materials, these bikinis not only look amazing, but it's also kind to the planet.

Our bikinis feature a classic triangle top with adjustable straps, ensuring a comfortable and customizable fit. The bottom features a flattering Brazilian cut that accentuates your curves, while still providing enough coverage to keep you feeling confident and comfortable.

But what really sets these bikinis apart are their vibrant and eye-catching designs. The stunning prints feature a mix of tropical florals and geometric patterns, inspired by the natural beauty of Bali. The colors are bold and bright, creating a look that is both playful and sophisticated.

Crafted with care and attention to detail, our bikinis are perfect for those who want to make a statement with their swimwear, while also doing their part for the environment. So why wait? Add our stunning and sustainable bikinis to your collection today and get ready to turn heads on your next beach adventure.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

The unique selling point of Ciami Bali is that it offers stylish and sustainable swimwear inspired by the tropical paradise of Bali. The brand's designs blend comfort, style, and sustainability, making it a go-to destination for those who want to look good while doing good. Ciami Bali uses eco-friendly materials, such as recycled nylon, and produces its swimwear using ethical and sustainable practices. By choosing Ciami Bali, customers can feel good about their purchase and know that they are making a positive impact on the planet. Additionally, Ciami Bali's designs are unique and eye-catching, featuring vibrant prints and flattering cuts that make a statement on the beach.


• Payment terms:

We accept all major credit cards, Paypal, Venmo, Apple and Google Pay
